title: Operational data-quality policy; canonical scientific split preserved
summary: Two TRAIN cases carry stray segmentation labels outside the BraTS value set {0,1,2,3,4}. Evidence (measured, see rationale) shows the production label conversion already maps ONLY {1,2,3,4} into WT/TC/ET, so the stray voxels become background and the resulting targets are valid and correctly nested. The cases are therefore validator-strict, NOT training-invalid. They are KEPT in training under an explicit, per-case, per-label tolerance. No case is excluded and the canonical split is byte-for-byte unchanged.

tolerated_seg_labels.reason: Isolated annotation artifact surrounded by background. Production _labels_to_regions maps only {1,2,3,4}; label 6 contributes to no region. Targets remain valid and correctly nested.
Isolated annotation artifact, almost entirely background-adjacent. Production _labels_to_regions maps only {1,2,3,4}; label 8 contributes to no region. Targets remain valid and correctly nested.

guarantees: The canonical split file and its SHA256 are unchanged.
Validation and test splits are untouched; no tolerance applies to them.
Tolerance is per-case AND per-label: only the exact listed labels on the exact listed case IDs are accepted.
Any other unexpected label, on any case, still FAILS the validator (fail-closed).
Nothing is auto-discovered: a case is tolerated only if listed here explicitly.
A missing, malformed, or unknown-ID policy file fails loudly.
No segmentation file on disk is modified; no label is remapped.
rejected_alternatives: Excluding the two cases from training: unnecessary, since their targets are valid; it would also reduce the train set below the canonical 898 and create a second de-facto split.
Rewriting the two seg files to remove the stray labels: modifies the dataset on disk and changes its content fingerprint.
Globally widening ALLOWED_SEG_LABELS: would silently accept genuinely corrupt annotations anywhere in the dataset.
